decisions.decision: VM shape: VM.Standard.A1.Flex at 2 OCPU / 12 GB
decisions.rationale: Console's Service Limits page showed 41 cores available, but that is the temporary Free Trial credit ceiling, not the permanent Always Free allocation (Pitfall 8: Oracle silently halved Always Free A1 from 4/24 to 2/12 in June 2026, undocumented). Sizing to the trial number risks reclamation/billing once the trial ends. 2/12 also matches plan 05-02's already-written conservative Redpanda memory/SMP caps, so no cross-plan changes needed.

decisions.decision: Public IP strategy: Reserved (static), address 144.24.239.175, already created via Networking > IP Management > Reserved Public IPs (no cost warning shown)
decisions.rationale: DNS A record, the SSH host fingerprint pinned in plan 05-05, and the OCI ingress rules all depend on this IP staying constant; an ephemeral IP would silently break all three simultaneously if the VM is ever recreated (a real possibility on free tier).

decisions.decision: OS image: Ubuntu 22.04+ LTS instead of the console's Oracle Linux 9 default
decisions.rationale: STACK.md recommends Ubuntu for the default 'ubuntu' user and broader community documentation for Docker-on-OCI; also matches the plan's requirement to install Docker from Docker's official apt repo rather than a distro package.

decisions.decision: Region: Switzerland North (Zurich), fixed (tenancy default, not changeable)
decisions.rationale: Read directly from the console top-right region selector.
